target.swarm_deny: a change outside 30-46 dBm / 4-10 degrees is denied by Cedar
target.swarm_autonomous_apply: Cedar allows the change inside the envelope and the network accepts it, with no person in between
target.swarm_verify: the next window is measured; a change that made things worse is undone
target.swarm_stabilization: a second change to the same cell right after is denied
target.swarm_trace: one trace id and contiguous records across the five AgentCore runtimes
target.critical_safe: after the change no critical cell (hospital, emergency, military) lost QoS
target.problem_to_command: one trace id from the Dynatrace problem to the command sent to Viavi
target.detect: Dynatrace opens a problem within 300 s of the fault's first record
target.one_problem: the fault opens exactly one correlated problem, not one per cell
target.judge: an independent judge scores the diagnosis and the fix >= 3/5

declared_by: track3-trigger Lambda, before the orchestrator starts
